note: Browsable SigLIP 2 zero-shot vocabulary for the website, grouped by clinical need and by visible design feature. It contains every query of crossmodal-queries-1.0.0 (same id and text, so their scores must reproduce) plus new queries written after the cross-modal results were seen. New queries are therefore exploratory: their precision is shown for orientation, never pooled into the pre-registered F10 estimate. A query is scored only when it maps unambiguously to one coarse category with at least 20 test-split records; everything else is unscored.
